events.title: Seattle Sounders FC becomes the first US Major League Soccer team to win the CONCACAF Champions League , defeating UNAM 5–2 on aggregate in the final . ( Sports Illustrated )

In association football , 프랑크푸르트 defeat the Glasgow 레인저스 5–4 on penalties to win the UEFA Europa League following a 1–1 draw after extra time in the final at the Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán Stadium in Seville , Spain. (CNN)
In association football , 리옹 defeat 바르셀로나 3–1 in the final at 유벤투스 Stadium in Turin , Italy, to win their eighth UEFA Women's Champions League title. (CNN)

맨체스터 시티 win their second consecutive Premier League title, their fourth in 5 years, and their sixth overall on the final day of the season following a 3–2 comeback against 애스턴 빌라 . 맨체스터 시티 win the league with 93 points, one point more than 리버풀 . This is the first time since 2019 that the title has been decided on the final day of the season. ( The New York Times )

A.C. AC 밀란 win the scudetto of the Serie A , the highest level of Italian league football , after finishing the season with 86 points, two points more than runners-up and their intercity rivals , 인테르 . AC 밀란 win their 19th Serie A title overall and their first since the 2010–11 season . (CNA)

The Premier League approves the sale of 첼시 F.C. to a U.S. consortium led by Los Angeles Dodgers co-owner Todd Boehly . 첼시 owner Roman Abramovich decided to sell the club after he was sanctioned over his connections to the Russian government . (BBC Sport)

In association football , Roma defeats 페예노르트 1–0 in the final at the Arena Kombëtare in Tirana , Albania , to win the inaugural edition of the UEFA Europa Conference League , the third tier of active European club football competitions . ( The Guardian )

Canada Soccer cancels a match between the Canadian and Iranian teams due to the latter's connection with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps , which shot down Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752 in 2020. (Sportsnet)

In association football , 레알 마드리드 win a record 14th UEFA Champions League title after defeating 리버풀 1–0 in the 2022 UEFA Champions League Final at the Stade de France near 파리 FC , with Vinícius Júnior scoring the winning goal. Kick-off was delayed by 36 minutes due to ticketed fans being prevented from entering the stadium. French police fire tear gas at 리버풀 supporters. UEFA blamed the delay on 리버풀 fans trying to enter the stadium with fake tickets and blocking the turnstiles. ( The Guardian ) ( The Telegraph ) (AP)
